newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE oil products price trends were mixed on Wednesday, traders said.
Gas oil barge premiums eased 50 cents, but the drop was offset by a $1 a tonne gain on futures. Cargoes were steady.
Gasoline eased in line with weaker crude, thin demand and healthy ARA stocks. Eurograde barges traded at $197 fob ARA in early trade, but sellers were holding out for $199 later on.
Naphtha was steady to slightly stronger in thin trade.
High sulphur barge prices were traded and valued around $86 a tonne fob ARA in early business, unchanged from Tuesday's late levels with some light short covering supportive.
